{{Top|leg}}
The '''Imperial Center Construction Contracts Division''' was in charge of construction projects on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. 

The ministry planned building projects funded by the Empire, military facilities and other public works. Occasionally their projects involved the building of palaces for minor [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisor]]s, after gutting city blocks in order. Such works boosted construction firms, they engaged in firrce competition bidding against each other; some became corporate giants thanks to such minor projects.<ref name="sb">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> 

The [[slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Perit]] was officially transferred from [[Byblos/Legends|Byblos]] to the CCCD, owing to his observed talent in technology. Soon he was taken in the service of [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]].<ref name="sb" />

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]] it was headed by [[Bentu Pall Tarlen]], who oversaw bidding on project contracts and had the final say on evaluating the lowest bidder. Tarlen was actually bought off by the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] and made sure that its fronts took the major projects. [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]]'s criminal empire not only profited from them, but also made sure to plant [[Holocamera/Legends|holocams]] and [[Microphone/Legends|microphones]] in their construction.<ref>''[[The Secrets of Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]''</ref><ref name="sb" />
